chunks: And from him, from Salamah, who said: Zayd ibn Abi Zayd al-Harawi narrated to me from Qutaybah ibn Sa'id, who said:
The Messenger of Allah (s.a.a.w.) said: Whoever comes to me as a visitor in Madinah, anticipating (the reward from Allah), I will be his intercessor on the Day of Judgment.

key_terms.مُحْتَسِباً: Anticipating reward / Seeking reward from Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the Prophet in Madinah according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarah, Ibn Qulawayh records this hadith to establish the spiritual efficacy of visiting the Prophet’s tomb in Madinah, emphasizing that the visitor’s sincerity (iḥtisāb) triggers the Prophet’s personal intercession (shafāʿah) on the Day of Judgment. This tradition underscores the Shia belief in the continued spiritual presence and agency of the Prophet after his death, linking physical pilgrimage to eschatological reward.
